newsitem.title: USA: Sunglass sees strategies affecting margins.
newsitem.headline: Sunglass sees strategies affecting margins.

text.p: Sunglass Hut International Inc said Thursday it expects its operational strategies to reduce and rebalance inventory levels to depress gross profit margins in the second quarter.
Inventory levels were reduced through a combination of inventory returns and exchanges with vendors as well as through price reductions of certain products, the company said.
Sunglass Hut said that its June comparable store sales were hurt by negative performance internationally, even while North American comparable store sales were up 2.3 percent.
The company reported an increase of 1.3 percent in June comparable store sales.
